name: – Emma Ytterell – Article 5, after § 2 – Am 115
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 2a. The maintenance, cleaning and clearing of riverbeds, ravines, drainage channels, irrigation channels and existing flood defence works, including dredging, desilting, removal of debris and sediment, restoration of water flow and reinforcement of existing protective infrastructure as well as the management of vegetation and forest fuel for the prevention of wildfires, including brush clearing, removal of deadwood, controlled vegetation management and the creation and maintenance of firebreaks which restore or preserve theexisting functionality, safety or resilience of the land or infrastructure shall not constitute projects or changes to projects within the meaning of Directive 2011/92/EU and shall not be subject to screening or an environmental impact assessment.
